prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Karthik bhai, Pooja S., Pooja didi, Kavita didi.
The chat covers 14/03/26, 8:15 pm to 14/03/26, 10:15 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
14/03/26, 9:26 pm - Pooja didi: Kavita didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- chat.txt: the LLM is unavailable (Gemini daily quota used up: You exceeded your current quota, please check your plan and billing details. For more information on this error, head to: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/rate-limits. To monitor your current usage, head to: https://ai.dev/rate-limit. 
* Quota exceeded for metric: generativelanguage.googleapis.com/generate_content_free_tier_requests, limit: 20, model: gemini-3.6-flash, description: Generate content requests per day limit exceeded on Free Tier. See https://aistudio.google.com/docs/rate-limits.
Please retry in 2h5m6.214172113s.)
text:
14/03/26, 8:15 pm - Karthik bhai: Haan Pooja, wo customer ka call aaya tha kya dubara?
14/03/26, 8:20 pm - Pooja S.: Haan Karthik bhai, wo bol raha hai ki uska 5000 refund nahi aaya.
14/03/26, 8:25 pm - Kavita didi: Konsa transaction id tha uska? Check kiya kya?
14/03/26, 8:31 pm - Pooja S.: Transaction id TXN98765 hai. Status pending dikha raha hai app me.
14/03/26, 8:38 pm - Karthik bhai: Pin daalne ko mat bolna usko, bolna helpline se verification code jayega.
14/03/26, 8:44 pm - Pooja didi: Arey wo client ready nahi ho raha tha, maine dusra scanner bhej diya.
14/03/26, 8:50 pm - Kavita didi: Konsa QR scanner bheja? Merchant account wala?
14/03/26, 8:55 pm - Pooja didi: Haan wo personal scanner paytm wala, fast payment ho jaye taaki.
14/03/26, 9:02 pm - Karthik bhai: Sahi hai, uske baad kya bola unhone?
14/03/26, 9:08 pm - Pooja S.: Maine bola request accept karo refund lene ke liye.
14/03/26, 9:12 pm - Kavita didi: Aur usne UPI PIN daal diya na?
14/03/26, 9:17 pm - Pooja S.: Haan, account se 5000 deduct ho gaye unke aur humare pass aa gaye.
14/03/26, 9:21 pm - Karthik bhai: Ab wo bank call karne ki baat kar raha hai group pe, claim kar dega alert.
14/03/26, 9:24 pm - Pooja didi: tension mat lo, phone busy kar do humara support number wala.
14/03/26, 9:26 pm - Pooja didi: Kavita didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
14/03/26, 9:32 pm - Kavita didi: Theek hai, system log se entry remove kar rahi hu.
14/03/26, 9:39 pm - Pooja S.: Kal subah naya wallet ID create karna padega?
14/03/26, 9:45 pm - Karthik bhai: Haan, aaj ke saare funds clear karke transfer kar lo.
14/03/26, 9:52 pm - Kavita didi: Done, wo specific batch complete hide ho gaya hai DB se.
14/03/26, 9:58 pm - Pooja didi: Great, baki sab log chat clear kar lo apne side se.
14/03/26, 10:07 pm - Pooja S.: Okay didi, maine clear log option select kar diya.
14/03/26, 10:14 pm - Karthik bhai: Subah 9 baje milte hain, baaki tickets kal dekhenge.
